purpose: Heavy Rebuild clean-master architectural program for a ruined public library with legible civic entry, collections, reading, staff, archive, and service functions.
architectural_rules: The entry sequence must resolve naturally to information/checkout before branching into major public collections.
Stacks must form readable aisles and collection zones rather than arbitrary dense block fields.
Reading and study spaces must receive plausible daylight or civic interior emphasis and remain distinct from service/storage zones.
Closed archive and processing spaces must connect to staff circulation and delivery without becoming unrestricted public shortcuts.
If multilevel, public vertical circulation must connect actual collection or reading destinations and retain supported landings.

damage_doctrine.intent: Public library abandoned and partially collapsed while retaining collection geometry, civic reading spaces, and discoverable archival evidence.
